entities.summary: Louis Fred Stokes is an American former professional football player who was a defensive end for 10 seasons in the National Football League (NFL). He played college football for the Georgia Southern Eagles. He played in the NFL for the Los Angeles/St. Louis Rams, Washington Redskins and New Orleans Saints
